scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with explicit finite-sample bound and nonasymptotic exact counts; finite program assertions and simulation are corroborative only. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform iid bins, the linear noncyclic statistic, and no joint-growth claim beyond \(N=o(n^{2/3})\); optimality of the range and non-null test power are not established. Classical Chen-Stein Poisson approximation is an acknowledged input. Priority remains subject to independently inspecting any separate sparse/null-distribution companion manuscripts.
title: Independent birthday laws for sparse ordered-histogram variation
